LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.5 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Fluency (rhythm
Topic 2.6: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading 2.5 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Fluency (rhythm in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How does reading fluency help in effective communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read texts and underline vocabulary related to common ingredients and items used in the kitchen (烤箱、冰箱、菜 板、刀、锅、铲子、木勺, 糖、盐、 油、葱、西红柿、蒜 etc.),

2. listen and read along to audio clips on common food items (鸡蛋、鱼、样肉、 牛肉、猪肉、鸡肉、乌加利、米饭、蔬 菜、菠菜)and their preparation methods (煮、炒、炸、煎、蒸、炖、烤),

3. read a dialogue and answer the questions collaboratively,

4. rearrange jumbled up sentences correctly and read them aloud to their peers,

5. take turns to read varied texts aloud for constructive peer feedback on their fluency.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read texts and underline vocabulary related to common ingredients and items used in the kitchen (烤箱、冰箱、菜 板、刀、锅、铲子、木勺, 糖、盐、 油、葱、西红柿、蒜 etc.),
2. listen and read along to audio clips on common food items (鸡蛋、鱼、样肉、 牛肉、猪肉、鸡肉、乌加利、米饭、蔬 菜、菠菜)and their preparation methods (煮、炒、炸、煎、蒸、炖、烤),
3. read a dialogue and answer the questions collaboratively,
4. rearrange jumbled up sentences correctly and read them aloud to their peers,
5. take turns to read varied texts aloud for constructive peer feedback on their fluency.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: the learner builds meaningful relationships with their peers as they work collaboratively in rearranging

jumbled up sentences correctly.

Values:
Unity: team spirit is displayed as the learner works together with their peers to respond to questions from the dialogue.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

Learners link their learning to English and Kiswahili when applying fluency skills across varied texts to enhance comprehension.
